description: Holistic board review — backlog + deferred tasks in one pass. Surfaces strategic context (ADs, phases, docs), grouping signals, merge candidates, priority drift, and stale tasks. "prepare" assembles context for you to analyse; "apply" commits your decisions after user confirmation. "route-unrecorded" is the executor the unrecorded-work offer points at: it creates a task per commit that landed on the base branch without ever reaching the board, synthesizes a BUILD HANDOFF from the change, and lands it In Review. Does not call the Anthropic API.

llm_response.description: Your reconciliation output (mode "apply" only). Must include a JSON block after <!-- PAPI_RECONCILE_OUTPUT --> with a "corrections" array.

mode.description: "prepare" (default) assembles full board context. "apply" commits your confirmed decisions. "route-unrecorded" pulls commits that landed without a task into the active cycle as In Review tasks with synthesized BUILD HANDOFFs (the action the unrecorded-work offer names).

project.description: Optional project slug or UUID. Bind reconciliation explicitly before reading or mutating board state.

name: board_reconcile
